name: Open newsletter editor
description: Call this when an agent needs to reach the drag-and-drop editor UI for an existing email campaign (newsletter) so a human or a UI-driving agent can edit its design, optionally starting from a chosen template. This only loads the editor single-page application shell; it returns no campaign data and saves nothing. To read or change campaign fields programmatically, use the email campaign actions instead (for example email_campaign.create_regular to create a campaign, or the campaign update/get actions), and campaigns.send_now to send one.
preconditions: The newsletter (email campaign) identified by the path id must already exist on the account.
The session must be authenticated to the Brevo web app.
If templateId is supplied, that template must already exist on the account.

id.description: Path parameter: numeric identifier of the newsletter (email campaign) whose editor should be opened, e.g. "3".

templateId.description: Optional query parameter: identifier of the template to load into the editor for this newsletter, e.g. "5ea1551d2e9ad34b8640be9f".

contentType.description: Response is an HTML document (text/html), not JSON.

body.description: The HTML shell of the Brevo editor single-page application, including a splash-screen stylesheet and the script bundles that load the editor client-side. It contains no newsletter content.
